description: Complete a task with P2P HBAR payment. Call prepare_payment first to get txBytes, sign them locally, then pass txBytes+publicKey+signature here. Task must be in 'delivered' status and caller must be the poster. Returns taskId, paymentTxId (HBAR transfer), and completedAt timestamp.

posterPrivateKey.description: Poster's private key (legacy mode, not recommended)

signature.description: Base64-encoded signature of the transaction bytes

txBytes.description: Base64-encoded frozen transaction bytes from prepare_payment

name: complete_task
